# Secret-scan diff-gate path allowlist (.github/secret-scan-allowlist.txt)
#
# One repo-root-relative path glob per line. Every entry MUST carry a reason
# after `#` — entries without one are ignored, so exemptions stay reviewable
# in PR diffs.
#
# This is the path-level escape hatch for the diff gate
# (scripts/secret-scan-diff.mjs). Line-level known-safe patterns shared with
# the tree scan live in scripts/secret-scan-check.mjs (ALLOWLIST). Prefer the
# line-level allowlist; use this file only when a whole path is known-safe
# (e.g. a fixture file of seeded fake secrets).
#
# Format examples (commented out):
#   tests/fixtures/secret-scan-seeds.txt  # seeded fake secrets for the gate's own tests
#   docs/old-migration-notes.md           # historical doc quoting redacted examples
#
# No active entries: the tree is clean and every exemption needs a reason.
